description: Reviewable Directus flow definitions for VAMO Business Portal standalone credit-card management. Replace <STRIPE_SECRET_KEY> with the environment's Stripe secret key before importing.

newFlows.name: Stripe - Create SetupIntent
newFlows.description: Creates a standalone Stripe SetupIntent for the authenticated business user ($accountability.user) without charging a payment or modifying subscriptions.

newFlows.name: Stripe - Finalize Card Setup
newFlows.description: Verifies a completed Stripe SetupIntent on the backend, confirming status === 'succeeded', customer ownership, and attached card payment method.

newFlows.name: Stripe - Set Default Payment Method
newFlows.description: Sets the customer's default invoice payment method and updates the active subscription's default_payment_method without charging or modifying subscription plan/schedule.

operations.name: Update Customer Invoice Default Payment Method

existingFlowEnhancements.name: Stripe - Get Payment Methods
existingFlowEnhancements.backwardCompatibleChange: Add GET /v1/subscriptions?customer={{customerId}}&limit=5 and return defaultPaymentMethodId (resolved from activeSub.default_payment_method || customer.invoice_settings.default_payment_method || null) alongside paymentMethods[]

existingFlowEnhancements.name: Stripe - Detach Payment Method
existingFlowEnhancements.backwardCompatibleChange: Verify PaymentMethod belongs to customerId and reject detaching the effective renewal card when an active subscription exists (code: RENEWAL_CARD_PROTECTED).
